current_workspace_observation.scope: read-only census interval before this storage integration; not a frozen filesystem image

conditions: Buckets apply to distinct new roots; do not count the same bytes twice or delete existing user data to fit.
Each period bucket includes database, rollback/statement journal allowance, checkpoints, metadata and temporary boundary duplication; main DB cap alone is insufficient.
Bind actual state/temp paths and measured external environment bytes to the storage envelope before allocation; unknown external bytes fail closed.
Installers, unwrapped logs and other writers are not an OS-wide quota; stop and re-audit before using them.
Keep latest and initial recovery points, data partition identity, uncertainty markers and failure evidence; no automatic deletion of old data.
A ceiling may stop or refuse a write before minimum training volume is complete. It does not prove these ceilings suffice for the required course.
Do not start formal training from this planning file. Real assets, functionality, peak review and parent start notification remain required.
